text: メールを　もたせるのを　やめますか？

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can stop or talk about. もたせるのを　やめる = 'stop making (it) hold'.

patterns.name: 〜せる
patterns.explanation: せる after a verb means making or letting someone do it. もたせる = 'make hold, give to hold'.
